learning_objectives.vi: Giải thích một nguyên nhân, hệ quả và ví dụ trong câu trả lời Speaking Part 3.

content.vi: Dùng because để nêu nguyên nhân, as a result để chỉ hệ quả, rồi đưa ví dụ thật hoặc giả định hợp lý. Không khẳng định tuyệt đối khi thiếu bằng chứng.
content.en: Link a cause to its effect and illustrate it. Use cautious language when the effect is only possible.

strategies.vi: Làm bài trước khi xem đáp án; ghi lại câu chưa chắc và giải thích vì sao đáp án đúng.
strategies.en: Attempt the task first, then explain why the supported answer is right.

passages.title: S-A
passages.text: Speaking about education often requires candidates to describe systems, explain causes and effects, and make suggestions using modal verbs such as should and must. In longer answers, students should link ideas clearly and give examples.

instruction.vi: Mỗi câu nêu một ý, thêm because, so hoặc as a result để nối nguyên nhân với hệ quả.

questions.prompt_en: Give one cause of parents spending a lot on private education.
questions.prompt_vi: Give one cause of parents spending a lot on private education.

answer.model_en: One cause is that parents want extra support to help their children get high grades.
answer.model_vi: One cause is that parents want extra support to help their children get high grades.

questions.prompt_en: Give one effect of students studying from morning until night.
questions.prompt_vi: Give one effect of students studying from morning until night.

answer.model_en: An effect is that students may not have enough free time to socialise.
answer.model_vi: An effect is that students may not have enough free time to socialise.

questions.prompt_en: Why might students feel unhappy when studying English?
questions.prompt_vi: Why might students feel unhappy when studying English?

answer.model_en: They may spend too much time memorising vocabulary and not enough time using the language.
answer.model_vi: They may spend too much time memorising vocabulary and not enough time using the language.

questions.prompt_en: Suggest one way to improve the education system using should.
questions.prompt_vi: Suggest one way to improve the education system using should.

answer.model_en: The government should reduce unnecessary testing and invest more in practical learning.
answer.model_vi: The government should reduce unnecessary testing and invest more in practical learning.

questions.prompt_en: Suggest one way parents can help children do better at school.
questions.prompt_vi: Suggest one way parents can help children do better at school.

answer.model_en: Parents should create a regular study routine and encourage reading at home.
answer.model_vi: Parents should create a regular study routine and encourage reading at home.
